newsitem.title: USA: EMC on track for over 25 pct revs, EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: EMC on track for over 25 pct revs, EPS growth.

text.p: EMC Corp said it is on track for earnings and revenue growth of over 25 percent for 1996 and it expects to achieve $750 million in 1996 revenues from its open systems business.

"The expectation is that we will grow revenues over 25 percent from last year's base period," Michael Ruettgers, EMC president and CEO, told reporters on a conference call, adding that its base revenues is before its acquisition of McData.
"We expect both revenues and earnings to be up more than 25 percent," he added.
EMC reported third quarter earnings of $0.37 a share.
According to First Call, the consensus on Wall Street was for earnings of $0.36 a share.
EMC also said its third quarter also reflected stronger- than-expected revenues in the IBM-compatible mainframe storage market, during what is traditionally a weaker quarter.

"The consolidation of vendors in this market is indeed causing customers to think twice before investing in a confusing array of disparate products from competitors," Ruettgers said. He also the rate of price declines in mainframe storage has also stabilized.

The storage maker also plans a big product announcement next Tuesday, but the company declined to provide many details on the announcement, except to acknowledge that software was a bigger component of this launch than in previous product announcements.
